name: Luna: Dirty Deeds
source:
Luna: Dirty Deeds is a story about Luna showing a world-class of dirty play at the Championship!

This girl will stop at nothing to lead her team to victory - even if it means pushing the limits of what's appropriate on stream! As the broadcast operator, you control the camera feed: switch angles, zoom in on the action, and follow her bold, unconventional tactics. Whether she's in full gear or suddenly decides less is more, it's all part of her daring playstyle - and it's all live!

[From [url=https://titdang.itch.io/dirty-deeds]itch.io[/url]]
